experiment: P8a train-only multi-axis long-tail manifest atlas
research_question: Can a reproducible six-class VFT-targeted label-combination-visibility long-tail protocol be constructed from paired nine-power train identities without mixing identities across roles or treating power views as independent samples?
single_changed_axis: data sampling contract only; no network, loss, calibration, threshold, checkpoint, or router is evaluated

identity_roles.role_contract: 63 combinations; per combination optimization=280, early_stop=40, calibration=40, development=40; all roles identity-disjoint
identity_roles.future_use_rule: P8a selected identities are protocol-only and cannot later serve as candidate training, selection, calibration, development, confirmation, or test evidence.

balanced.combination_target: uniform subject to exact label and sample constraints

combo_lt.combination_tail: even-cardinality nonempty combinations target 10 samples each; odd-cardinality combinations absorb the remaining mass subject to exact marginal labels

mixed_lt.combination_tail: even-cardinality nonempty combinations target 10 samples each; odd-cardinality combinations absorb the remaining mass subject to exact marginal labels
mixed_lt.visibility_tail: for VFT-positive identities that also contain at least one fixed component, deterministically select one of 10/15/20 dB; every other identity uses 30 dB

promotion_rule: A passing P8a atlas establishes only a reusable data protocol. It cannot promote a long-tail method. A subsequent P8b must use fresh, non-P8a identities, a separate preregistration, an equal-compute BCE control, three development model seeds, per-class AUPR/FPR and hard-negative separation gates before any confirmation.
stop_rule: If any validity gate fails, do not repair the manifest after observing a model result. Record the failure, keep all P8a identities out of later candidate selection, and redesign on a new protocol seed.
